crossRefs.note: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”
Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be…
Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him…
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

translations.web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
translations.bsb: May your father and mother be glad, and may she who gave you birth rejoice!
translations.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
translations.asv: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, And let her that bare thee rejoice.
